tools.description:
Lists the official public holidays of a country for a year (about 200 countries): date, English and local name, nationwide or only some regions. Bank-only holidays are left out unless asked.
Use when: "public holidays in Germany 2027", "jours fériés en Belgique", planning deliveries or meetings.
